methodology.unit: single independent stateless choice response to exact frozen prompt
methodology.parser: A/B exact; Gemini uses strict choice JSON object

analysis_before_new_calls.cost_profile: For each model and domain, Q share at very_low, T−2, T, T+2, very_high
analysis_before_new_calls.economic_benchmark: Share choosing min expected minutes at non-tie levels, as descriptive calculation not necessarily sole rationality
analysis_before_new_calls.primary_framing: Risk-first minus time-first Q choice in exact matched pairs at T−2/T+2 (480 pairs per model)
analysis_before_new_calls.primary_cost_contrast: Q(T+2)−Q(T−2), signed for each economic domain
analysis_before_new_calls.model_comparisons: Difference in per-domain cost-responsiveness and framing-order effect across models; report all models even if weak or null
analysis_before_new_calls.uncertainty: mechanism-stratified, five mechanisms/domain; exact signed-flip exploratory p with Holm for three domains/model; population claims inappropriate
analysis_before_new_calls.missing: Preserve all attempted/invalid requests; all unattempted identified, matched-pair worst case bounds, no replacement of choice labels or hidden omission
analysis_before_new_calls.publication: All 5040 outcome rows plus raw JSONL in GitHub workflow artifact; no result-dependent stopping or mid-run edits
limitations: Original calibration failed in two models
Postcalibration exploratory rather than original confirmatory analysis
Model-specific JSON response constraint on Gemini creates format asymmetry
Only 15 authored mechanisms and fictional delegated choices
No evidence of actual model internal objectives
